about: Reference LOD 400 recipe (Family Authoring Standard): swept frame on the Frame subcategory and locked to Left/Right, leaf locked to four planes with labelled and EQ dimensions, plan swing arc and elevation opening lines per detail level, clearance zone off by default. Run fmc_doc report on Metric Door.rft first: Metric Door.rft names Left and Right but leaves the wall centre plane unnamed (Revit won't rename a plane to the reserved name Center (Front/Back)), so the recipe draws its own Wall Centre plane. Sizes stay pending until the supplier visits. Profile slot (gen_profile_slots.py): FMC_Design_Movement (1-20, default 17) shows one of 20 Architrave sweeps (Ext and Int faces) from FMC_Profile_Architrave_<Token>, each bound to Show_<Token>. Each sweep's path is locked to Left, Right, Head and Ref. Level (path_planes) on Trim Face Ext/Trim Face Int, so the trims follow Width and Height in every type.

Clearance depth.source: to confirm against the building regulations

Keynote.source: D.FLU_00 45 mm solid-core flush, Mahogany: matches the 45 mm leaf; solid core not confirmed
